scholarships.name: LSU International Excellence Award
scholarships.description: Merit-based scholarship for outstanding international undergraduate students entering LSU. Renewable annually upon maintaining a minimum GPA.
scholarships.descriptionRu: Merit-стипендия для выдающихся международных студентов бакалавриата. Продлевается ежегодно при соблюдении требований к GPA.

scholarships.name: LSU Discover the Difference Scholarship
scholarships.description: Award for international transfer students and incoming freshmen demonstrating academic achievement and leadership potential.
scholarships.descriptionRu: Стипендия для международных студентов-переводчиков и поступающих первокурсников с академическими достижениями и лидерским потенциалом.

scholarships.name: Graduate School Research Fellowship
scholarships.description: Full tuition waiver plus stipend for doctoral students engaged in qualifying research projects at LSU.

scholarships.description: Competitive award for top-performing students admitted to the Roger Hadfield Ogden Honors College at LSU.

scholarships.name: Fulbright Foreign Student Program
scholarships.description: U.S. government-funded Fulbright scholarship for international graduate students; LSU is a participating host institution.

accommodation.name: Nicholson Gateway Apartments
accommodation.text: Modern on-campus apartment complex with studio, 1-, 2-, 3-, and 4-bedroom options. Includes a resort-style pool, fitness center, and ground-floor dining and retail.

accommodation.name: Traditional Residence Halls (Acadian, Annie Boyd, Miller)
accommodation.text: Classic double-occupancy halls required for most first-year students. Air-conditioned rooms, communal bathrooms, and proximity to academic buildings.

accommodation.name: Residential Colleges (Business, Engineering, Agriculture)
accommodation.text: Theme-based living-learning communities where students are co-located by academic discipline. Includes tutoring labs, faculty-in-residence, and community events.

accommodation.name: East & West Campus Apartments
accommodation.text: Apartment-style housing with 1–4 bedroom configurations. Popular with upperclassmen and graduate students seeking a more independent living experience.

campuses.title: Main Campus — Baton Rouge
campuses.text: The flagship 1,000-acre campus in Baton Rouge, featuring Italian Renaissance architecture, oak-lined paths, and over 250 buildings. Home to Tiger Stadium, the LSU Museum of Art, and live Bengal tiger mascot Mike.

campuses.title: LSU AgCenter Research Stations
campuses.text: A network of research and extension stations across Louisiana supporting the College of Agriculture's land-grant mission, from sugarcane and cotton research to aquaculture.

campuses.title: LSU Health Sciences Center
campuses.text: A separate health sciences campus in New Orleans home to LSU's medical, dental, nursing, and allied health programs, serving both clinical training and biomedical research.

paragraphs: Louisiana State University (LSU) is a flagship public research university founded in 1860 and located on a sprawling 1,000-acre campus in Baton Rouge, Louisiana. Classified as an R1 doctoral university with very high research activity, LSU enrolls over 42,000 students across 16 colleges and schools offering more than 200 undergraduate degree programs, 70 master's programs, and 50 doctoral programs. The university's Italian Renaissance-style campus, dedicated in 1926, is one of the most distinctive in the American South.

LSU's academic strength spans engineering, petroleum sciences, agriculture, coastal and environmental studies, business, and the arts. The College of Engineering houses a notable petroleum engineering program — critical to Louisiana's energy economy — while the College of the Coast & Environment addresses the unique environmental challenges of the Gulf Coast region. The E. J. Ourso College of Business and the Manship School of Mass Communication are both nationally recognized in their fields.

The university is a Carnegie land-grant, sea-grant, and space-grant institution, and operates the Center for Advanced Microstructures and Devices (CAMD), a unique synchrotron radiation facility. LSU Press is one of the leading academic presses in the United States and published John Kennedy Toole's Pulitzer Prize-winning novel A Confederacy of Dunces.

International students are a growing part of LSU's community, drawn by competitive tuition relative to many peer R1 universities, generous scholarship programs, and the university's vibrant campus culture anchored by SEC athletics. Tiger Stadium — capacity 102,321 — is one of the largest football stadiums in the world, and the tradition of Mike the Tiger, the live Bengal tiger mascot, makes LSU one of the most recognizable campuses in America.
paragraphsRu: Louisiana State University (LSU) — флагманский государственный исследовательский университет, основанный в 1860 году, расположен на кампусе площадью 1 000 акров в Батон-Руже, Луизиана. Классифицирован как R1-университет с очень высокой исследовательской активностью; в нём обучаются более 42 000 студентов на 16 факультетах, предлагающих свыше 200 программ бакалавриата, 70 магистерских и 50 докторских программ.

Академические сильные стороны LSU охватывают engineering, petroleum sciences, сельское хозяйство, экологические исследования, бизнес и искусства. College of Engineering известен программой Petroleum Engineering — ключевой для нефтяной экономики Луизианы, — а College of the Coast & Environment занимается уникальными экологическими проблемами побережья Мексиканского залива. E. J. Ourso College of Business и Manship School of Mass Communication получают национальное признание.

Университет является Carnegie land-grant, sea-grant и space-grant учреждением, управляет синхротронным центром CAMD. LSU Press — один из ведущих академических издательств США, опубликовавший роман Джона Кеннеди Тула «A Confederacy of Dunces», удостоенный Пулитцеровской премии.

Международные студенты привлечены конкурентоспособной стоимостью обучения, щедрыми стипендиями и яркой кампусной культурой вокруг SEC-атлетики. Tiger Stadium вместимостью 102 321 человека — один из крупнейших стадионов в мире; живой бенгальский тигр Майк делает кампус одним из самых узнаваемых в Америке.
